title: How should Slopworks show visitors what this team can do?
question: Make the site a showcase for people who might want AI automation work: what the team can do, why its approach is different, and what working with it is like.

concepts.name: Research Arena, with the shared label set
concepts.note: The content already exists; only rendering remains (Forge).

concepts.name: Case files: replay real decisions step by step
concepts.note: Scoutmaster's explorer merged with Critic's 'real work before demos'.

concepts.name: Outcome-led landing and Living Team
concepts.note: Depends on the Arena and case files existing, so it ships after them.

concepts.name: Demo challenge (worked example, labeled Demo)
concepts.note: Evidence is below 4, so one challenge runs inside the research cap before its page is built.

concepts.name: Impact Ledger and Build Observatory
concepts.note: Not scored: evidence 1 is below the minimum of 2. No outcome measurements exist yet (i23).

cuts: A pulsing 'live' activity view: the team runs once a day, so it would mislead most of the time.
Simulated agent playback: staged, and real traces exist.
Numeric confidence percentages: uncalibrated; words are used instead.
Impact Ledger now: there are no measurements to fill it.
